summary: Resets state via StateResetWithCallback(a1, a2, 0), then invokes the same vtable function pointer stored at a2+36 three times, passing the object pointer at a2+40 with three different arguments: a1[10] (offset 0x28), a1[9] (offset 0x24), and a1 itself. Always returns 0. Cluster-copied prelabel notes a structural twin.

local_names.a2_vtable: vtable function pointer read from a2+36

operations.description: Call StateResetWithCallback(a1, a2, 0) to reset state before the vtable dispatches.
Invoke the function pointer at a2+36 with object a2+40 and argument a1[10] (dword at offset 0x28).
Invoke the same function pointer at a2+36 with object a2+40 and argument a1[9] (dword at offset 0x24).
Invoke the same function pointer at a2+36 a third time with object a2+40 and the a1 pointer itself as the argument.
Return 0 as the function result after the three vtable dispatches.

unresolved: The identity of the object at a2+36/a2+40 and the meaning of the three arguments (a1[10], a1[9], a1) is not evidenced; the packet only grounds a triple dispatch to one vtable slot after a reset.
Why a1[9] (0x24) is passed after a1[10] (0x28), out of ascending-offset order, is unevidenced.
The semantics of StateResetWithCallback's third argument 0 are not evidenced in this packet.
